name: Luna 21 / Lunokhod 2
left: Luna 21 lander + Lunokhod 2 rover (final resting position)
fact: Lunokhod 2 was the second of two Soviet lunar rovers (1973). Driven by a 5-person ground crew rotating in shifts at the IKI control centre. In 4 months it covered ~37 km — the lunar-surface distance record that stood for 41 years until NASA's Opportunity Mars rover passed it in 2014. Carried French laser retroreflectors that are still used for Earth-Moon ranging today.
capability: Long-distance teleoperated mobility — proved a remote crew can drive an unmanned vehicle across an alien surface in real time (with light-delay).
